display_long_description:
Project Withered is a high-energy, physics-based multiplayer experience inspired by Gorilla Tag, built around fast movement, intense chases, and pure skill. Instead of traditional controls, players rely on hand-based locomotion to run, climb, jump, and launch themselves across the environment, creating a unique and highly competitive playstyle.

Set in a mysterious, worn-down world, Project Withered introduces players to environments that feel abandoned, decayed, and alive at the same time. From crumbling structures to eerie forests, every map is designed to challenge movement skills while adding to the game’s unsettling atmosphere. The “Withered” theme brings a darker twist, making every match feel immersive and unpredictable.

Gameplay revolves around fast-paced tag-style mechanics where players must either chase others down or survive as long as possible. Quick reactions, smart movement, and map knowledge are essential if you want to win. No two rounds ever feel the same, thanks to the freedom of movement and constant player interaction.

Project Withered also features:

Custom-designed maps with vertical movement and hidden routes.
Multiple game modes to keep gameplay fresh and exciting.
Skill-based mechanics that reward practice and creativity.
Interactive environments that enhance strategy and exploration.
Ongoing updates with new content, improvements, and features.
